entries_end_month_valid.name: entries_end_month_valid
entries_end_month_valid.value: "entries"."end_month" is null or (extract(day from "entries"."end_month") = 1 and "entries"."end_month" >= "entries"."start_month" and "entries"."recurrence" in ('monthly', 'yearly'))

entries_installments_valid.name: entries_installments_valid
entries_installments_valid.value: ("entries"."recurrence" = 'installments') = ("entries"."installments" is not null) and ("entries"."installments" is null or "entries"."installments" >= 1)

entries_transfer_fields.name: entries_transfer_fields
entries_transfer_fields.value:
case when "entries"."kind" = 'transfer'
        then "entries"."to_account_id" is not null and "entries"."to_account_id" <> "entries"."account_id" and "entries"."category_id" is null and "entries"."pot" is null
        else "entries"."to_account_id" is null end
